name: Reading

queries.query: site:gov.uk HM Land Registry Reading Berkshire cadastral parcel polygons map API
queries.result: First-party discovery identified HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons as the open England-and-Wales parcel-boundary source, with monthly local-authority GML downloads. It also identified the Reading Borough Council land-charges procedure, which requires a plan and is not a cadastral parcel API.

queries.query: Reading Berkshire parcelles cadastrales carte officielle HM Land Registry données ouvertes
queries.result: The local-language variant is English in the United Kingdom; this distinct query also resolved to the official HM Land Registry INSPIRE dataset and Reading Borough Council land-charges route. No separate Reading municipal cadastral custodian or parcel API was evidenced.

registryBasis: HM Land Registry is the evidenced national land-registration/cadastral custodian for England and Wales and publishes the INSPIRE Index Polygons dataset. Reading Borough Council is evidenced only as a local land-charges procedure, not as a cadastral parcel custodian.

requests.outcome: Official HM Land Registry guidance returned. It describes open INSPIRE Index Polygons for registered freehold property in England and Wales, monthly updates, GML delivery, and a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE identifier; extents are indicative, not title-plan boundaries.

National Data Library record returned and attributed the dataset to HM Land Registry; it states that files are divided by local-authority area in England and Wales and are available under the Open Government Licence.

The public download route redirected repeatedly in the bounded anonymous curl request and was not followed beyond the redirect limit. No file, schema payload, or parcel geometry was fabricated or retained.

Official service documentation states that its REST API requires an account, licence agreement, and API key for the listed datasets; no account, credentials, or private token was used. The free INSPIRE download is documented as bulk GML with no API.
Reading Borough Council land-charges page returned. It documents a paid local search procedure requiring an up-to-date plan and forms; it does not evidence an anonymous cadastral parcel map/API.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons covers indicative positions and extents of registered freehold property in England and Wales, distributed by local authority.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official guidance and catalogue metadata were verified; no Reading download file or geometry response was obtained in this attempt.

runtimeReadinessReason: The source is real and public, but this attempt did not qualify a bounded Reading geometry response or adapter independently. This packet is not source integration or admission.
remainingUncertainty: The exact Reading local-authority GML download URL and its current schema/CRS were not retrieved because the public download route redirected repeatedly. INSPIRE polygons are indicative freehold registration extents, not a complete cadastral parcel fabric; leasehold and unregistered land are outside this open subset. The WUP point was preserved and was not used as evidence of absence.
